defects.title: The documented flux tolerance sTol is ignored in the minimisation step, which always uses 1e-6
defects.trigger: rng(1); identifyFastBlockedRxns(model, model.rxns, 0, 1e-2) with model = createModel({'EX_B', 'R_fwd', 'R_tiny', 'R_rev', 'EX_A', 'R_blk'}, {'EX_B', 'R_fwd', 'R_tiny', 'R_rev', 'EX_A', 'R_blk'}, {' -> B', 'B -> A', 'B -> A', 'A <=> B', 'A -> ', 'C -> D'}, 'lowerBoundList', [0 0 0 -1e-3 0 0], 'upperBoundList', [10 10 1e-3 0 10 10], 'printLevel', 0)
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25) returns {'R_blk', 'R_tiny'}: the forward-only R_tiny (at most 1e-3) is reported blocked because 1e-3 < sTol, but the reverse-only R_rev (at most -1e-3) is reported unblocked because line 79 compares with 1e-6. With the default sTol the call returns {'R_blk'}
defects.expected: sTol applied in both steps: {'R_blk', 'R_rev', 'R_tiny'} for sTol = 1e-2

notes: Reproduction (gurobi): model = createModel({'EX_B','R_fwd','R_tiny','R_rev','EX_A','R_blk'}, {'EX_B','R_fwd','R_tiny','R_rev','EX_A','R_blk'}, {' -> B','B -> A','B -> A','A <=> B','A -> ','C -> D'}, 'lowerBoundList', [0 0 0 -1e-3 0 0], 'upperBoundList', [10 10 1e-3 0 10 10], 'printLevel', 0); rng(1); identifyFastBlockedRxns(model, model.rxns, 0, 1e-2) -> {'R_blk','R_tiny'} (R_rev missing); rng(1); identifyFastBlockedRxns(model, model.rxns, 0) -> {'R_blk'}. The defect is confined to calls with a non-default sTol: no src caller passes sTol (prepareFastGapFill, connectRxnGapfilling, findFluxConsistentSubset, runTestsOnModel use 1-3 arguments), so the callers do not reach it. Lead decision: severity unusable-option (quarantine) vs limitation (sTol is honoured in the maximisation step and the default equals the hard-coded 1e-6).
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: code read: line 79 uses 1e-6 instead of sTol (documented option without effect, R5); seed NONE; writer reproduced in MATLAB

defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25) warning "There is no gMCS to check", then MATLAB:unassignedOutputs "Output argument "IsCutSet" (and possibly others) not assigned a value in the execution with "checkGeneMCS" function." defects.expected: the outputs returned (NaN), as the branch for an empty gMCSs intends

defects.title: geneNotMinimal lists the genes that are needed, not those that make the set not minimal

notes: Reproduction (gurobi): m = changeObjective(createModel({'EX_A','R1','R2','BIO'}, {'EX_A','R1','R2','BIO'}, {' -> A','A -> B','A -> B','B -> '}, 'upperBoundList', [10 1000 1000 1000], 'grRuleList', {'', 'g1', 'g2', ''}, 'printLevel', 0), 'BIO'); [a, b, c] = checkGeneMCS(m, {}) -> MATLAB:unassignedOutputs; [a, b, c] = checkGeneMCS(m, {{'g1'; 'g2'}, {'g1'}}) -> a = [1 0], b = [1 1], c{1} = {'g1'; 'g2'} for the minimal cut set {g1, g2}. Row gMCS cells ({'g1','g2'}) work. Legacy test/verifiedTests/analysis/testGeneMCS/testGeneMCS.m (function under test calculateGeneMCS) also calls checkGeneMCS (lines 84, 96) and was not touched. Also cosmetic, not recorded: line 56 showprogress(0, ...) has no semicolon and prints 'ans = []'. No src callers.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: code read: line 79 stores the genes above the threshold (needed genes) as geneNotMinimal; lines 41-45 leave outputs unassigned for empty gMCSs; default reach; writer reproduced in MATLAB
